description_for_human: Browse 5,705+ indexed OpenClaw AI agent skills across 10 categories, with install guides and Trust Scores.
description_for_model: ClawSkills is a directory of OpenClaw AI agent skills. It indexes 5,705+ skills across 10 categories including AI & LLMs, Search & Research, Web & Frontend Dev, DevOps & Cloud, Browser & Automation, Productivity & Tasks, Marketing & Sales, Coding Agents & IDEs, Notes & PKM, and Health & Fitness. 71 skills have their own detail page with an install command, a Trust Score, use cases, and FAQs. Trust Score methodology is published at /methodology. The site also features comparison tools, tutorials, articles, and a glossary of AI agent terminology.
